How to Use Garden Horizons Calculator

1

Select Your Plant

Click on any crop from the grid in the Garden Horizons Calculator. It automatically loads base stats.

2

Set Ripening Stage

Drag the slider or tap a preset: Unripe (1.0×-1.9× range), Ripened (2.1×-2.9× range), or Lush (3.0× fixed).

3

Choose Color Variant

Select Normal (1×), Silver (2×), Gold (5×), or Rainbow (10×).

4

Add Weather Mutations

Tap mutation icons to stack bonuses. Mutations are multiplicative—combine Sandy (2.5×) with Soaked (1.2×) for 3.0× total.

5

Adjust Weight & Quantity

Enter your plant's actual weight and quantity. Hit "Base" to reset weight instantly.

6

Get Your Price

See exact Shilling sell price, profit, and ROI—updated in real-time.

How Does Garden Horizons Calculator Work?

Garden Horizons Calculator uses the exact same formula as the Garden Horizons game:

Sell Price = Base Price * (Weight / Base Weight)² * Mutation Product * Ripening * Color

Base Price

Each plant has a fixed base value set by the game.

Weight Scaling

Weight matters exponentially. A crop twice its base weight sells for 4× the price.

Mutation Product

All selected weather mutations multiply together. Three mutations = product of all multipliers.

Ripening

Unripe (1.0×-1.9× range), Ripened (2.1×-2.9× range), Lush (3× fixed). Lush gives maximum returns.

Color Multiplier

Normal (1×), Silver (2×), Gold (5×), Rainbow (10×). Stack with everything else.

Profit & ROI

We subtract seed cost from total revenue to show your actual profit and ROI.

Why Use This Garden Horizons Calculator?

Maximizing your farm's potential in Garden Horizons shouldn't feel like a math class. Our calculator helps you make better farming decisions every day:

Stop Guessing, Start Profiting

Don't waste time hauling low-value crops to the market. Know exactly how many Shillings you'll earn before you even harvest.

Master the Math

The game uses "Quadratic Scaling" for weight, which is tricky to calculate manually. We handle the heavy lifting with 100% accuracy.

Optimize Your ROI

We don't just show sell price—we calculate Net Profit. By subtracting seed cost, we help you decide which plants are worth your time.

Mobile-Ready for Grinding

Keep the calculator open on your phone while you play on PC. Our responsive design means you have a pro-level farming assistant in your palm.

Frequently Asked Questions

What Can Garden Horizons Calculator Do For Me?▼
Garden Horizons Calculator takes the guesswork out of farming! Simply select your crop and multipliers, and we'll predict your final payout. We automatically subtract seed cost to show your exact net profit.
How Accurate Is Garden Horizons Calculator?▼

The game uses: Final Value = Base Price * (Weight / Base Weight)² * Mutation Product * Variant

Weight Matters: Because of quadratic scaling, weight is king! A plant twice its base weight sells for 4× the price.

Variant Multiplier: Combination of Ripening (Lush 3×) and Color (Gold 5×). A Gold Lush plant gives 15× multiplier!

Which Plants Are Best For Profit in Garden Horizons Calculator?▼
For early-game, Carrots and Onions offer the best ROI. As you progress, look into Cherry or Plum. These multi-harvest crops with high-tier mutations can yield millions of Shillings per harvest.
How Do Mutations Work in Garden Horizons Calculator?▼
Mutations are multiplicative, so stacking is key. Starstruck (6.5×) is the most powerful single mutation (Starfall events). Stack it with Shocked (4.5×) for 29.25× total. Toggle mutations in our calculator to see instant price impact.
Where Does Garden Horizons Calculator Source Its Data?▼
Base prices vary significantly between crops. Whether you're looking for carrots, onions, or any other crop, find them all in our plant grid. We keep our database updated with the latest in-game values.
Can I Use Garden Horizons Calculator on Mobile?▼
Yes! We know most players are busy tending to their gardens, so our calculator is fully mobile-optimized. Check your potential profits on your phone or tablet while you play.
Will Garden Horizons Calculator Get a Reverse Mode?▼
It's currently in development! We're working on a feature that lets you input a "Target Shilling Amount" so the tool can tell you exactly what weight or mutation you need to reach that goal. Stay tuned!
Why is my in-game sell price slightly different from the Garden Horizons Calculator?▼
Don't worry, this is totally normal! While the Garden Horizons Calculator uses exact data-mined formulas from the developers, things like Roblox server lag or sneaky micro-updates to the game code can occasionally cause a tiny variance of just a few Shillings. Even with those rare hiccups, the Garden Horizons Calculator's precision is sufficient for making major planting decisions and remains the most reliable tool for forecasting your crop's ROI. You can definitely count on it to plan your next harvest!
